title: Context Engineering
subtitle: Designing AI That Understands, Remembers, Acts and Learns
description: A book on the discipline behind AI software that works. It argues that most AI project failures are context failures, not model failures, and sets out a practice: model the domain, ground answers in an explicit knowledge graph, budget context deliberately, give agents memory and learning that can be reviewed, and keep a named person accountable for what gets accepted. The argument runs from why AI software fails differently, through knowledge graphs and deterministic search, to evaluation, controlled action and enterprise governance.
